action_summary: Removes the object every earlier round supplied: the goal. A goal is a boolean function of the run, so hypotheses are bitmasks over reachable runs and two goals are the same knowledge exactly when their masks are equal. Measured on 231 executed TARBALL runs: 11 935 hypotheses, 353 behaviours, 79 statements stating the user's goal exactly, four different intentions that are one behaviour until the next machine separates them on 32 of 196 runs. Active questions reach the ceiling in 8 judgments (8.46 bits) where the environment's own order reaches 4.32; the environment itself is learned exactly (229 of 231 decided, 0 errors) from a depth-3 table.

obs_solution.efficiency_mechanism: One pass of the grammar over the reachable runs produces every hypothesis as an integer; a question is then a bit-count over surviving masks, and the whole identification costs 158 s for two machines, 427 runs and 12 881 hypotheses.
obs_solution.generality_mechanism: Nothing in the measurement is specific to these machines: the ceiling is the number of distinct behaviours of a supplied grammar on a reachable set, and the transfer test is the same pair evaluated elsewhere.
obs_solution.losing_routes_reason: Refining the statistic further: 3 cells, exact, and still a behaviour. Asking more questions: already optimal at 8 judgments for 8.46 bits. A bigger model: refused by owner law and unnecessary for a count.

truth.the_law_this_round_adds: Experience identifies a behaviour, not an intention. An environment has a finite resolving power -- 353 behaviours over 11 935 hypotheses here -- and that is the ceiling of everything experience inside it can buy; active questions reach the ceiling in its own logarithm, the environment's own order reaches half of it, and the class left behind is exactly what the next environment splits.
what_is_false_in_the_claim: that experience identifies the goal: 79 statements state it exactly and are one behaviour
that what is learned stays true permanently: a class of four intentions splits on 32 of 196 runs of the next machine
that asking more fixes it: 8 judgments already carry 8.46 bits, the ceiling is not a budget
that earlier rounds measured the goal: they measured a supplied predicate, and the receipt now says so in a count
that any of this is sentience or intention: it is a behavioural class, priced, and the distinction is the round's point
